deliverables: 12 months of production maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support
Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
Transparent capped time-and-materials reporting with milestones and evidence
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ADA, consisting of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The funded work is limited to hardware-wallet compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work, and is not intended to build a new wallet product.
The proposer claims continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor changes could otherwise break secure hardware-wallet access for users and integrators.
The proposal says the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting, documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
Funds are to be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with stated TRSC and PSSC addresses and a public dashboard for auditability.
The proposal states that oversight will involve Intersect and technically capable third parties, including milestone-based disbursement controls and reporting obligations.

The Oversight Committee is stated to consist of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with defined multi-party authorization thresholds for key treasury contract actions.

The proposal discloses prior treasury and Project Catalyst funding related to hardware wallets, Ledger app work, Plutus enhancement, security, native tokens, and capture-the-flag work through multiple external links.

The proposer claims the work aligns with Cardano strategy Pillar 1 for security, reliability, and interoperability and secondarily with Pillar 2 for adoption, secure UX, developer experience, and tooling compatibility.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ADA for 12 months of hardware-wallet maintenance, with a single main work package, an Intersect administration fee, smart-contract-based fund management, oversight controls, and several externally checkable references for process, prior funding, and treasury administration.
